name: WF-071 Comparable Sales & Market Evidence Adapter Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const s=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const asset=s(input.asset_type??input.property_type??'residential').toLowerCase(); const id=s(input.property_id??input.parcel_id??input.lead_id??input.deal_id); const subject=input.subject_property??{}; const comps=Array.isArray(input.comps)?input.comps:[]; const missing=[]; if(!id)missing.push('canonical_identity'); if(!subject.address&&!subject.lat&&!subject.lon&&!subject.zip&&!input.market_area)missing.push('subject_location_or_market_area'); if(!comps.length)missing.push('comparable_sales'); const normalized=comps.map((c,i)=>({rank:i+1,address:s(c.address),sale_price:n(c.sale_price??c.price),sale_date:s(c.sale_date??c.date),distance_miles:n(c.distance_miles),acres:n(c.acres),sqft:n(c.sqft),beds:n(c.beds),baths:n(c.baths),property_type:s(c.property_type??asset),source:s(c.source),verified:Boolean(c.verified)})); const prices=normalized.map(c=>c.sale_price).filter(v=>v!==null&&v>0); const avg=prices.length?prices.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/prices.length:null; const median=prices.length?[...prices].sort((a,b)=>a-b)[Math.floor((prices.length-1)/2)]:null; const verified=normalized.filter(c=>c.verified).length; const evidenceQuality=!comps.length?'none':verified===comps.length?'strong':verified>0?'mixed':'unverified'; const land=asset.includes('land')||asset.includes('vacant'); return[{json:{ok:missing.length===0,adapter:'wf-071',canonical_identity:id||null,asset_type:asset,market_evidence:{subject_property:subject,market_area:s(input.market_area),comps:normalized,summary:{comp_count:normalized.length,verified_comp_count:verified,average_sale_price:avg,median_sale_price:median,evidence_quality:evidenceQuality},methodology:land?'land_sales_and_price_per_acre':'comparable_sales_and_property_similarity'},provenance:{sources:normalized.map(c=>c.source).filter(Boolean),raw_evidence_preserved:true,no_inference:true},missing_requirements:missing,next_action:missing.length?'Collect subject location and comparable sale evidence before valuation.':'Use the evidence set for valuation/MAO analysis and flag any unverified comps for review.',policy:{evidence_first:true,verified_data_preferred:true,market_value_not_guaranteed:true,70_percent_rule_secondary:true,no_legal_validation:true,no_title_clearance_claim:true,no_funding_verification_claim:true}}}];
